claim: Try the reviewer with a risky sample plan already visible in the first screen.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:risky-sample-review
sandbox: fresh desktop and 390px contexts; click the landing action; assert the populated mapping and error verdict intersect the first viewport; open /?demo=1

claim: Demo — sample data, nothing is saved to the real draft.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:demo-isolated
sandbox: save a real draft, edit and reset /demo/, inspect both IndexedDB names, then use Start for real and prove the real draft is unchanged

test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:local-only
sandbox: capture every request while loading and editing the demo; assert every request is same-origin

test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:offline-reload
sandbox: visit /demo/, wait for the service worker, take the browser offline, reload, and review the seeded data

test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:dry-run-export
sandbox: make the demo sample safe, download the shell plan, and assert its mode prints commands only

test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:collision-and-path-risks
sandbox: demo input with a duplicate destination, a root escape, and an absolute path; assert each reported risk

claim: Paste two columns, import a file, or derive names with a rule.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:input-methods
sandbox: demo mode; paste a table, import a CSV fixture, and derive two expected outputs with a regex rule

claim: Quoted CSV, tab-separated, and semicolon-separated files are supported.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:delimited-inputs
sandbox: demo mode; parse quoted CSV, TSV, and semicolon input and assert the displayed paths

claim: Generated scripts check existing sources, destinations, and temporary paths before any rename.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:script-preflight
sandbox: download a live script and execute it in temporary directories with a missing source, occupied destination, and occupied temporary path; assert no source moves

test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:errors-block-scripts
sandbox: direct demo with the reserved-name error; assert shell and PowerShell exports are disabled

test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:destination-comparison
sandbox: demo input with case-normalized duplicate destinations; assert the collision finding

claim: Checks Windows reserved names and trailing dots or spaces.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:portability-checks
sandbox: demo input with a reserved Windows name and a quoted trailing dot/space; assert both findings

claim: Builds a two-phase order for swaps and cycles.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:reversible-cycle-order
sandbox: download and run a live swap in a temporary directory, apply the exported undo mapping as a staged plan, and verify original contents

test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:powershell-export
sandbox: safe demo swap; assert the PowerShell download contains both mappings, preflight, temporary staging, and dry-run output

test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:undo-export
sandbox: two demo mappings; parse the JSON download and assert each destination maps back to its source

claim: Exports the reviewed mapping as CSV.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:reviewed-csv-export
sandbox: two demo mappings including commas; assert the header, quoting, and one row per mapping

claim: Drafts use IndexedDB on this device and survive a refresh.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:draft-persistence
sandbox: real mode; save a draft, reload, assert the restored value and rename-plan-reviewer IndexedDB database

claim: Plus is US $12 once, adds one combined review packet, and checkout is currently unavailable while existing licenses still work.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:plus-offer-status
sandbox: fresh demo; prove free checks and exports remain available, assert price and checkout state, then mock a valid existing license and export the combined packet
